title: Continuum Backup & Recovery Restore Terms — Restore Labor, Test Restores and Recovery Time
content:
Under Continuum Backup & Recovery a restore is started within the tier's restore response time of the request, as a target. Restore labor is included where the tier includes restore labor; otherwise the logged minutes are rounded up to the tier's restore billing increment and billed at the tier's hourly restore rate, rounded half up to the cent. Test restores up to the tier's included test restores per contract year are included on every tier; further test restores are billed as restore labor at the tier's hourly restore rate even where restore labor is otherwise included. Where the tier's recovery time is guaranteed and a full-system restore or failover misses the tier's recovery time target, the tier's refund percentage of that month's plan fee is refunded by the accounting team; the recovery time target is otherwise a target only. Overnight shipment of a seeded recovery drive costs the tier's expedited drive shipment fee per shipment, billed with the restore labor. Restores are possible after closing only within the tier's post-cancellation retention days.

Each of the six tiers, Continuum Backup Basic through Continuum DRaaS Premier, applies its own three figures to these terms: whether restore labor is included, the hourly restore rate, and the number of included test restores per contract year.

## Kinds of recovery job

A restore or test restore is requested by the client or by the service desk, and each job has its own reference. A job is a file-level restore, a full-system restore or a test restore. When a job completes, the technician minutes are logged against it.

## Restore labor

| Kind of job | Tier includes restore labor | Tier does not include restore labor |
|---|---|---|
| File-level or full-system restore | Included | Logged minutes rounded up to the billing increment, billed at the hourly restore rate |
| Test restore within the year's included number | Included | Included |
| Test restore beyond the year's included number | Billed as restore labor at the hourly restore rate | Billed as restore labor at the hourly restore rate |

**Billed labor amount.** The logged minutes, rounded up to the billing increment, divided by 60 and multiplied by the hourly restore rate, rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures only).** On a hypothetical tier that does not include restore labor, with an hourly rate of 120.00 USD and a 30-minute increment, a restore logging 70 minutes is rounded up to 90 minutes, that is 1.5 hours, and billed at 180.00 USD. A restore logging exactly 60 minutes stays at 60 minutes and is billed at 120.00 USD.

## Counting test restores in the contract year

The contract year runs from the latest anniversary of the term start date through the day before the next anniversary. Within it, completed test restore jobs and ended full DR test failovers are counted, by type. Test restores up to the tier's included test restores per contract year are included; each further test restore in the same contract year is billed.

For example, on a hypothetical tier including 2 test restores per contract year, the first and second completed test restores of the contract year are included, and a third in the same contract year is billed as restore labor at the hourly restore rate. At the next anniversary the count starts again.

## Recovery time refund

| Tier's recovery time | A full-system restore or failover misses the recovery time target |
|---|---|
| Guaranteed | The tier's refund percentage of that month's plan fee is refunded by the accounting team |
| Not guaranteed | The recovery time target is a target only |

For example, on a hypothetical guaranteed tier with a 10 percent refund and a plan fee of 1,000.00 USD for the month, a missed target gives a refund of 100.00 USD.

## Recovery drives and restores after closing

Overnight shipment of a seeded recovery drive is charged at the tier's expedited drive shipment fee for each shipment and billed together with the restore labor. After the plan closes, a restore is possible only within the tier's post-cancellation retention days.
